messages:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — AWS Marketplace security wants SOC2, a redacted pen-test report, the completed security questionnaire, and an IP‑sanitized architecture diagram by EOD Friday. Can someone own this?
Sarah: I can run point on artifacts. Which SOC2 file do we have for sharing?
Alex: It's SOC2_TypeII_2024-09.pdf under s3://redwood-sec/reports/. We should only share the attestation + auditor letter (redact org-specific PII). :lock:
Maria: They'll also ask for the date range and auditor contact — I can pull the attestation letter and a short summary.
Kevin: Who's the Marketplace contact? Need to confirm they accept redacted pentest and whether a separate intake portal is required.
Jordan: Contact is marketplace-security@awsmarketplace.com (cc Amanda). The portal notes "redacted pen-test + executive summary" is acceptable. They still require the questionnaire filled out.
Sarah: Plan: 1) Create redacted pen-test executive summary (no vuln IDs/customer domains), 2) export the SOC2 attestation PDF, 3) complete the marketplace questionnaire spreadsheet. @Alex can you sanitize the network diagram?
Alex: Yes. I'll remove hostnames and internal IPs, replace with roles. Command I'm using locally: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://infra-diagrams/arch_v2.dot .
python scripts/sanitize_diagram.py arch_v2.dot arch_v2_sanitized.dot
aws s3 cp arch_v2_sanitized.dot s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/1769801123/
```
Sarah: Perfect. Maria, can you pick up the questionnaire sheet? We have last version at /docs/marketplace_security_questionnaire_2025.xlsx — update answers where things changed.
Maria: On it. I'll also prepare a short remediation timeline for any open high/critical findings. ETA: Thursday noon.
Kevin: Legal check: do we need an NDA addendum before sending pen-test artifacts? @LegalBot can you confirm?
LegalBot: @channel Legal confirms the existing Marketplace MSA covers exchanging attestation docs. For raw pen-test reports and logs, explicit consent is required — so send redacted executive summary only. Please include a one-line attestation that logs/raw data are withheld.
Jordan: OK — redacted summary only, include attestation note. Once artifacts are staged, I'll upload to the portal and notify Amanda. Target: Friday 17:00 PT. :calendar:
Sarah: I'll drop secure-share links here when uploads complete (no public presigned links).
deploy-bot: Reminder — do not paste presigned S3 links in public channels. Use secure-share or the vendor portal upload.
Alex: Acknowledged, will use secure-share (internal ACL).
Maria: Questionnaire + attestation draft will be ready Thursday 12:00 PT.
Jordan: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate to me immediately. :thumbsup:
